Date: 2022-03-17
REMARKS
Applicant respectfully requests entry of this preliminary amendment prior to examination of this application on the merits. New claims have been filed to reduce the filing fee and/or for proper U.S. format, and not for any reason related to patentability or to disclaim any subject matter over the prior art. Applicant reserves the right to pursue any canceled subject matter in this or one or more continuing application. Support for the new claims is found throughout the specification and the canceled claims. The new claims accordingly include no new matter.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any fee which may be required or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 02-1818. Please indicate the Attorney Docket No. 3724361.00429 (P50187PC00) on the account statement.
Respectfully submitted,
K&L GATES LLP
